## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

LOAD Data

```{r}
rssc_defense_spots <- read_tsv("<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/Figure_DefenseSystem/Data/SPOT_RGP_DEFENSESYS.tsv")
```

How many different defense system identified in RSSC pangenome

```{r}
rssc_defense_spots %>% 
  filter(GENETYPE == "DEFENSE") %>% 
  pull(SYSTEM) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  length()
```

Given the 110 different defence system, what are the distribution of each in different spots

```{r}
rssc_defense_spots %>%
  filter(SYSTEM != " ") %>%
  group_by(SPOT_ID, SYSTEM) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  arrange(-n) %>% 
  filter(SPOT_ID == "spot_70")

# 
#   summarise(distinct_defense = n_distinct(SYSTEM)) %>% 
#   arrange(-distinct_defense)
  
```

```{r}
rssc_defense_spots %>% 
  filter(SPOT_ID == "spot_57") 
```

```{r}
rssc_defense_spots %>% 
  filter(SPOT_ID == "spot_70") %>% 
  filter(SYSTEM != "NA") %>%
  filter(SYSTEM == "Mokosh_TypeI")
```

```{r}

defense_distribution <- rssc_defense_spots %>% 
  filter(SYSTEM != " ") %>% 
  # filter(SPOT_CHAR == "Hotspot") %>%
  group_by(SPOT_ID,SYSTEM) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = SYSTEM, names_from = SPOT_ID, values_from = n, values_fill = NA) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("SYSTEM") %>% 
  as.matrix()
  
# defense_distribution[is.na(defense_distribution)] <- ""
defense_distribution_2 <- defense_distribution
defense_distribution_2[is.na(defense_distribution_2)] <- ''

pheatmap::pheatmap(defense_distribution,
                     filename = "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/Figure_DefenseSystem/defense_distribution_all.pdf",
                      cellwidth = 10,
                      cellheight = 10,
                     border_color = "grey80",
                     na_col = "white",
                     cluster_rows = F,
                     cluster_cols = F,
                     height = 20,
                     width = 25,
                     display_numbers = defense_distribution_2,
                     # fontsize = 4,
                     number_format = "%.0f", 
                     colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(2000))
  

```

```{r}
defense_distribution <- rssc_defense_spots %>% 
  filter(SYSTEM != " ") %>% 
  filter(SPOT_CHAR == "Hotspot") %>%
  group_by(SPOT_ID,SYSTEM) %>% 
  count() %>% 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = SYSTEM, names_from = SPOT_ID, values_from = n, values_fill = NA) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("SYSTEM") %>% 
  as.matrix()
  
# defense_distribution[is.na(defense_distribution)] <- ""
defense_distribution_2 <- defense_distribution
defense_distribution_2[is.na(defense_distribution_2)] <- ''

pheatmap::pheatmap(defense_distribution,
                     filename = "<PROJECT_ROOT>/Manuscript_Figures/Figure_DefenseSystem/defense_distribution_hotspot.pdf",
                      # cellwidth = 20,
                      # cellheight = 20,
                     border_color = "grey85",
                     na_col = "white",
                     cluster_rows = F,
                     cluster_cols = F,
                     height = 20,
                     width = 15,
                   angle_col = 315,
                     display_numbers = defense_distribution_2,
                     # fontsize = 4,
                   fontsize_row = 15,
                   fontsize_col = 20,
                   fontsize_number = 15,
                     number_format = "%.0f", 
                     colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(200))
  
```
